memory.what_it_is: The agent has no separate note-store. Its memory is two things: the journal (every decision + how it turned out = experience) and the neural-net weights (the lessons distilled from that experience).

factors.note: These are the inputs the agent records for every directional call (the 'features' column) and later learns from. It does NOT yet track fundamentals, macro, or order-flow — those are the missing factors.
